description: Capture the visible screen and run approved desktop actions through separated macOS, Windows, and Linux Computer Use drivers. macOS uses the native Swift host first, Windows uses Win32/UIA drivers, and Linux prefers a rumiai-owned Xvfb/Openbox virtual desktop before visible desktop utilities. Use context/apps/windows, show_app to bring Vivaldi/Chrome/etc. to the main screen, and select_window before screenshots or actions. For visual clicks, use the zoom ladder: full or selected-window screenshot, crop/zoom the likely region with source=latest when the target is small, then click with normalized_x/normalized_y relative to that attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only when intentionally cropping the current crop again. Take a fresh full/selected-window screenshot before unrelated actions so old zoom coordinates are not reused. Hidden host-window control is disabled; background=true is limited to supported safe drivers.

config.name: computer_use
config.summary: macOS(Swift host)、Windows(Win32/UIA)、Linux(Xvfb仮想desktop優先 + visible fallback)を分けたComputer Use。LinuxではホストWaylandの裏ウィンドウを直接叩かず、rumiai所有のX11仮想DISPLAYを使える場合はそこで操作します。まず action=context/apps/windows で開いているアプリとウィンドウを確認し、必要なら show_app で Vivaldi/Chrome/VS Code/Finder/LINE などをメイン画面に表示し、select_window で対象ウィンドウを選んでから screenshot/click します。視覚クリックは full/selected-window screenshot -> source=latest の crop/zoom で候補領域を拡大 -> crop画像基準の normalized_x/normalized_y で click、という順にしてください。source=latest は直近のfull/selected-window画像から切り出します。今見ているcropをさらに切る意図がある場合だけ source=current_crop を使ってください。別操作へ移る前は fresh screenshot を取り、古いzoom座標を使い回さないでください。文字入力は action=type と text を優先してください。

action.description: Use open_url with url and optional app=Google Chrome/Vivaldi to open a website directly in the visible browser. Use context/apps/windows to inspect open apps, show_app with app/name to bring an app to the main visible screen, select_window with app/title to target a visible window, and screenshot before actions. For small or ambiguous image targets, do not click from the full screenshot; request screenshot crop/zoom/detail first, usually with source=latest, then click using normalized_x and normalized_y relative to the attached crop. source=latest crops from the last full/selected-window screenshot; use source=current_crop only for an intentional crop-of-crop. After a zoomed/cropped view, request a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions. point:[y,x] is legacy compatibility only. click/move/drag default to the virtual AI cursor and return marked previews without operating the real UI; set physical=true only after explicit approval to operate the visible UI. type/key/scroll return a post-action screenshot unless include_screenshot=false.

point.description: Legacy image-click coordinate as [y, x] normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot. Prefer normalized_x and normalized_y with coordinate_space=normalized_1000 for new calls.

point_order.description: Legacy point order. Use yx for point:[y,x] (default) or xy for point:[x,y]. Prefer normalized_x and normalized_y for new calls.

normalized_point.description: Legacy alias for point:[y,x] in normalized 0-1000 coordinates. Prefer normalized_x and normalized_y with coordinate_space=normalized_1000.

normalized_x.description: Preferred image-click x coordinate normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot. Use with normalized_y and coordinate_space=normalized_1000.

normalized_y.description: Preferred image-click y coordinate normalized from 0 to 1000 on the latest screenshot. Use with normalized_x and coordinate_space=normalized_1000.

from_x.description: Alias for drag start x coordinate.

from_y.description: Alias for drag start y coordinate.

to_x.description: Alias for drag end x coordinate.

to_y.description: Alias for drag end y coordinate.

text.description: Required non-empty text to enter when action is type. Prefer this over repeated key presses for words; use action=key for shortcuts.

key.description: Single key or shortcut key for action=key, for example backspace, return, or a with modifier=meta.

modifier.description: Optional single key modifier such as meta, command, control, shift, or alt.

key_combo.description: Optional key combo for action=key, for example command+a or shift+tab.

count.description: Number of times to press the key for action=key/backspace.

scope.description: For action=apps: running, installed, or all.

coordinate_space.description: Use normalized_1000 with normalized_x and normalized_y for preferred visual coordinates. Also supports screen for absolute display pixels, window/screenshot for selected-window pixels, and model_image for returned model preview pixels. point:[y,x] normalized_1000 coordinates are legacy compatibility only.

physical.description: Set true, after explicit approval, to operate the visible UI. Omit or set false to keep click/move/drag virtual-only.

virtual_only.description: For click/move/drag, keep the action as a marker and AI cursor preview without operating the real UI. This is the default unless physical=true is set.

crop.description: Optional screenshot crop region for inspecting a specific area before selecting or clicking a small target. Use coordinate_space=normalized_1000 and source=latest when cropping from the previous screenshot.

zoom.description: Optional screenshot zoom factor for inspecting small or ambiguous targets before clicking. Use with normalized_x/normalized_y as the center and source=latest to zoom into the previous screenshot.

source.description: For screenshot crop/zoom, set source=latest to crop from the last full/selected-window screenshot instead of taking a new full screenshot. Use source=current_crop only when intentionally cropping the currently attached crop again. Use a fresh screenshot before unrelated actions.

crop_x.description: Crop left coordinate. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is 0-1000 relative to the source screenshot.

crop_y.description: Crop top coordinate. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is 0-1000 relative to the source screenshot.

crop_width.description: Crop width. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is normalized width.

crop_height.description: Crop height. With coordinate_space=normalized_1000 this is normalized height.

normalized_box.description: Crop box in normalized 0-1000 coordinates. Use [left, top, right, bottom] unless box_format=xywh is supplied inside crop.

detail.description: Optional screenshot detail level such as standard or high_detail when crop/zoom inspection is needed.

open.description: For select_app: launch an installed app if it is not already running.

driver.description: Optional driver hint such as foreground_input or physical.

settings_fields.label: Default Target
settings_fields.help: Default desktop target for new tasks; request-specific details are supplied at call time.

settings_fields.label: Default Mode
settings_fields.help: Preferred operating mode before issuing desktop actions.

settings_fields.label: Safety Default
settings_fields.help: Durable safety preference for desktop operations.

settings_fields.label: Screenshot Quality
settings_fields.help: Default screenshot/detail preference for visual inspection.
